review:
Fortunes of Aztec is a 4x6 tumble game with a reel-clearing multiplier. Winning symbols are removed and replaced, and if every symbol on a reel is removed during a spin, the total win gains a 1x multiplier. This can happen several times in a single spin, so long cascade chains are rewarded twice.

Three or more scatters award free spins, with extra scatters adding spins up to a total of 25. In the bonus, the multipliers you earn persist between spins, so the round tends to build towards its end. Retriggers are possible. Pragmatic Play advertises a 10,000x maximum. The RTP is 96%, slightly below the studio's usual top setting. The reel-clearing idea gives it a different feel from the orb-based multiplier games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
